resources.string: Copy the script, open Termux, create install.sh, paste the script, run chmod +x install.sh, then run ./install.sh to install the build environment.

Release: Build a release APK
Debug: Build a debug APK
Apks: Build an AAB, then generate universal APKS
Clean: Clear the build cache
Ctrl C: Interrupt the current session

In the module, apply plugin: 'stringfog', set implementation to the algorithm's fully qualified class name, and add its runtime dependency. Enable buildFeatures.buildConfig for AGP 8+.

Custom algorithms implement IStringFog:
byte[] encrypt(String data, byte[] key)
String decrypt(byte[] data, byte[] key)
boolean shouldFog(String data)

IKeyGenerator.generate(String) can also be customized. AIDE uses the existing D8 to load the algorithm in memory; it does not evaluate arbitrary Gradle expressions.
